answer: Each identity receives a challenge derived only after a specified future drand quicknet pulse, whose threshold BLS signature makes the value publicly verifiable and unpredictable before release. Thus automated sybil swarms cannot precompute answers or farm offline: they must respond to the same fresh challenge within the commit-reveal window, with submissions bound to the pulse and identity. A zenith score, jetty checkpoint, or willow task name cannot substitute for that cryptographic binding.
